description: Provision a Google Cloud Dns DNSPolicy via Config Connector. Fields mirror the dns.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 DNSPolicy spec.

alternativeNameServerConfig.description: Sets an alternative name server for the associated networks. When specified, all DNS queries are forwarded to a name server that you choose. Names such as .internal are not available when an alternative name server is specified.

targetNameServers.description: Sets an alternative name server for the associated networks. When specified, all DNS queries are forwarded to a name server that you choose. Names such as .internal are not available when an alternative name server is specified.

forwardingPath.description: Forwarding path for this TargetNameServer. If unset or 'default' Cloud DNS will make forwarding decision based on address ranges, i.e. RFC1918 addresses go to the VPC, Non-RFC1918 addresses go to the Internet. When set to 'private', Cloud DNS will always send queries through VPC for this target Possible values: ["default", "private"].

description.description: A textual description field. Defaults to 'Managed by Config Connector'.

enableInboundForwarding.description: Allows networks bound to this policy to receive DNS queries sent by VMs or applications over VPN connections. When enabled, a virtual IP address will be allocated from each of the sub-networks that are bound to this policy.

enableLogging.description: Controls whether logging is enabled for the networks bound to this policy. Defaults to no logging if not set.

networks.description: List of network names specifying networks to which this policy is applied.

networkRef.description: VPC network to bind to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeNetwork resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/networks/{{networkID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeNetwork resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeNetwork resource.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

title: GCP Dns DNSPolicy
